programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 看看高級獸醫蒂姆指導新員工菲爾檢查受傷的考拉,並跟隨團隊為飽受夏季高溫困擾的動物們提供解決方案。共同慶祝獸醫卡琳娜解決了一個令人費解的青蛙問題,並放飛一個準備好飛翔的老朋友。

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #1
programme.desc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因。團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊、公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭。

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地。然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊: 死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝過昆士蘭東南地區,在繁殖與捕蛇的季節逐步升溫時,觀看阿黛兒與米克迎戰一條東部棕蛇,這是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同時史都與麗芙則與一條地毯蟒糾纏搏鬥。

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #1
programme.desc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因。團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊、公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭。

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地。然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情。

programme.title: 魔幻水域的祕密 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追蹤遍布全球閃閃發光的水域,從俄羅斯遠東的火山河流到佛羅里達充滿地熱的溪流。觀看海狸以巧妙精密的建築技術改變整片自然景觀,築起完整的水壩,塑造出新的水域生態;隨後,享受與海牛共度的冬季水療日,感受溫暖平靜的水中悠閒時光。

programme.title: 珊瑚之城 #3
programme.desc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡。​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升。暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務。

programme.title: 珊瑚之城 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜。隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上。別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領: 牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物。

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亞,一隻年老的豹子即將面臨生命中最嚴峻的挑戰: 一隻更年輕、更健康、更強壯的雌豹正逼近她的領土,準備爭奪它。這將是一場年齡和經驗對決年輕和活力的大戰。

programme.title: 靈長大地 #4
programme.desc: 貝拉貝拉狒狒隊伍是一個成功的查克馬狒狒族群,牠們在南非沃特伯格山脈的一個原始山谷中開枝散葉。但繁華背後卻有一個問題——牠們不是山谷中唯一的狒狒族群。

programme.desc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐。

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #6
programme.desc: 細看大型軍用C-5「銀河」運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻。

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #1
programme.desc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到托斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它。

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #2
programme.desc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部。

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #3
programme.desc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山、偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家。它們就是迷人的義大利島國。

programme.title: 創造之島
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事: 在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。

programme.title: 百萬美國公主 2 #4
programme.desc: 探索三位美國女性對英國時尚、室內設計甚至國會所產生的影響。南茜阿斯特、南希蘭開斯特和寶蓮德羅斯柴爾德都有不同的出發點,但每位都想出人頭地。

programme.title: 百萬美國公主 2 #1
programme.desc: 認識三位蛻變成現實生活中公主的女演員。一看葛麗絲凱莉、格洛麗亞斯旺森和麗塔海華斯從荷里活皇室一躍成為歐洲貴族後所帶來無與倫比的魅力。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園。懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子。兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為「力」的奇觀。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中。溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥、覓食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #2

programme.title: 阿姆斯壯

programme.title: 創造之島
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事: 在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #1
programme.desc: 在智利托雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度。河口、濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨。

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #2
programme.desc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長。深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮游植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎。

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #3
programme.desc: 這股洋流伴隨著智利獨特的藍鯨族群,也是其他極度稀有海洋哺乳動物的最後避風港。從冰冷深海到高崖強風,洋流塑造出奇特棲地,也是一部關於生存的自然研究。

programme.title: 恐龍效應
programme.desc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #1

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #2

programme.title: 台灣之最 #9

programme.title: 台灣之最 #10
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣便利店的五大隱藏功能。她逛逛附近的一家便利店,發現它不僅是一個喝咖啡和吃零食的地方。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #11

programme.title: 台灣之最 #12
programme.desc: 與祖莉來一場異國冒險,進入臺灣動物世界!

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園。懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子。兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為「力」的奇觀。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中。溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥、覓食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信、最複雜的天文台之一- ALMA。他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #3
programme.desc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運。米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #4
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的「重型運輸機」中隊。他們致力保持CH53「超級種馬」直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備。

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #4
programme.desc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟、似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #1
programme.desc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞、現代的高爾夫球場、神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園。懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子。兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為「力」的奇觀。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中。溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥、覓食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.desc: “Shark Business” unravels some of the mysteries surrounding sharks with controversial behaviorist Dr Erich Ritter You'll witness divers testing the limits of shark-human interaction outside of cages with dangerous sharks such as lemon, bull and even great white sharks!

programme.desc: Ian Gordon has been called upon to handle the delicate matter of moving an adult ragged tooth shark from one aquarium to another

programme.title: Animal Society
programme.desc: Explore the family dynamic of wildebeests, elephants, and giraffes as we take a trip around Africa

programme.title: Safari Flix

programme.title: 探險奇兵: 冒險新章 #1
programme.desc: 當一位兩百年前的圖書館員重現於現代,他喚醒了封閉已久的魔法圖書館,並意外復活了邪惡的德瑞卡瓦克。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #11

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #12
programme.desc: 3月14號,這對於一同度過情人節活動的兩人而言,是無法避免的比賽之日,西片準備進行的計畫究竟是什麼?而高木同學在3月14號又提出了何種請求?

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #7
programme.desc: 白石同學順利撐過期末考期間,沒被沒收遊戲機。然而第三學期一旦結束便會重新分班,「自己被久保同學發現的日子可能會迎來尾聲」,白石同學開始有這種寂寞的心情。而到葉月家借住一晚的久保同學在談及分班話題時,腦中也自然浮現白石同學的身影。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #8
programme.desc: 明天準備賞花的久保同學、沙貴、明菜三人到超市採買,偶遇帶著誠太的白石同學。久保同學像平時那樣向兩人搭話,而誠太竟對沙貴一見鍾情,明菜見狀便邀白石同學與誠太一起去賞花。然而在隔天舉辦的賞花宴會上,喝醉的明菜掀起了一陣風波。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #9
programme.desc: 終於升為二年級生的同學們忐忑不安,不受影響的白石同學進入教室後開始找座位。此時有人告訴他答案,而那個人竟是久保同學,他後來得知葉月以及玉緒也在同一班。開班會決定班級委員時,白石同學如同去年擔任環境委員,同班同學的須藤同學卻好像也記得這件事。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #10
programme.desc: 明天是學校的體檢日,認為自己可能長得比白石同學還高的久保同學向他提議比身高。於是白石同學將背緊貼牆壁,讓對方將尺固定在他的頭上。換久保同學貼著牆壁量身高時,白石同學發現用手固定尺的姿勢彷彿是在對她壁咚。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #7
programme.desc: 莉莉在與「素體」的戰鬥中精疲力竭,並失去了意識。阿久津抱起了她,並把她送回了她的房間。阿久津本欲離去,卻被意識模糊的莉莉抓住衣角,無法動彈。無奈之下,他只好坐在房間讀角落。過了一陣子,莉莉醒了過來。她發現阿久津已經睡著了,於是她便悄悄地接近了他的身邊。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #8
programme.desc: 夕香等人看到了阿久津和莉莉一起從公寓中出來。儘管他們迫切地想要澄清他們並沒有共度一晚,但班上的同學卻沒有那麼容易放棄追問……這時候,夕香對阿久津提出了一個出乎意料的建議……她居然邀請他去約會……!?

programme.title: 海賊王 #16
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #6
programme.desc: 島井多惠和一隻妖貓生活在港口小鎮。當她路過漁港時,發現有大量的魚屍體被沖上岸,鎮民擔心這是「善太的詛咒」。戶平善太以已故孫子的外貌製作一尊木偶後便死去,從此木偶會在夜晚四處走動,小鎮上發生令人聯想到木偶皮諾丘童話的異變。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #7
programme.desc: 琴子在妖怪們的委託下前往拜訪多惠。她察覺這尊一到夜晚就會隨機電死大量魚群的木偶身上寄宿著落於本地的「某異物」之力,具備與世間常理相悖的神祕力量。琴子等人立即著手計劃消滅木偶,然而它身上卻隱藏著一個祕密。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #8
programme.desc: 除了飯店經營外還發展各種事業的音無集團會長・音無剛一要求私下和琴子會面。他的妻子曾在路上遇到劫匪,因此喪命。剛一對琴子坦承是他間接害死了妻子,時日無多的剛一希望將自己是殺人犯的事實詳細告訴孩子們。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #9
programme.desc: 終於升為二年級生的同學們忐忑不安,不受影響的白石同學進入教室後開始找座位。此時有人告訴他答案,而那個人竟是久保同學,他後來得知葉月以及玉緒也在同一班。開班會決定班級委員時,白石同學如同去年擔任環境委員,同班同學的須藤同學卻好像也記得這件事。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #10

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #8
programme.desc: 除了飯店經營外還發展各種事業的音無集團會長・音無剛一要求私下和琴子會面。他的妻子曾在路上遇到劫匪,因此喪命。剛一對琴子坦承是他間接害死了妻子,時日無多的剛一希望將自己是殺人犯的事實詳細告訴孩子們。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #1
programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一場突如其來的悲劇--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜歡上在網路遊戲「救世主之森(FOS)」認識的女生。茜在FOS裡靠攻擊弱小角色發洩情緒,並遇見同屬一個公會的山田。茜不經意間向他傾訴與戀人分手的事,導致大大改變了她的人生。

programme.title: 海賊王 #18
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸內一片混亂之際,萊利娜的前未婚夫布魯克斯將她綁走。在馬車中清醒過來的萊利娜嘗試說服綁匪們放走自己,毫不意外地以失敗告終。但她仍抓住馬車因車輪損壞而停下來的破綻逃入森林之中。當她心想總算能穿過樹叢的那一瞬間,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #6
programme.desc: 萊利娜不小心在努爾的馬上睡著了。當她在隔天早上醒來時,發現自己睡在努爾的臥房,旁邊還躺著赤裸著上半身的他。萊利娜在情急之下拜託亞當幫她逃離此處。被留在房間的努爾命令執事長奇德翁動員所有騎士搜尋兩人,但萊利娜早已為了躲避搜索而假扮成女僕。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸內一片混亂之際,萊利娜的前未婚夫布魯克斯將她綁走。在馬車中清醒過來的萊利娜嘗試說服綁匪們放走自己,毫不意外地以失敗告終。但她仍抓住馬車因車輪損壞而停下來的破綻逃入森林之中。當她心想總算能穿過樹叢的那一瞬間,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #6
programme.desc: 萊利娜不小心在努爾的馬上睡著了。當她在隔天早上醒來時,發現自己睡在努爾的臥房,旁邊還躺著赤裸著上半身的他。萊利娜在情急之下拜託亞當幫她逃離此處。被留在房間的努爾命令執事長奇德翁動員所有騎士搜尋兩人,但萊利娜早已為了躲避搜索而假扮成女僕。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #12
programme.desc: 3月14號,這對於一同度過情人節活動的兩人而言,是無法避免的比賽之日,西片準備進行的計畫究竟是什麼?而高木同學在3月14號又提出了何種請求?

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #1
programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一場突如其來的悲劇--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜歡上在網路遊戲「救世主之森(FOS)」認識的女生。茜在FOS裡靠攻擊弱小角色發洩情緒,並遇見同屬一個公會的山田。茜不經意間向他傾訴與戀人分手的事,導致大大改變了她的人生。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 萊利娜收到了弗麗絲答應給她的,於錫克雷特山脈召開的魔物討伐戰邀請函。依照討伐戰慣例,女性將贈送手帕給男性,男性則會將捕捉到的魔物獻給女性。努爾之前從未收下任何人的手帕,也從未獻上魔物給任何人。到了討伐戰當日,努爾對萊利娜提出了某項要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努爾將被稱作山之主的魔物獻給了萊利娜後,讓兩人的距離從原本的契約關係逐漸開始有了變化,卻也讓萊利娜的命運籠罩在不祥的陰影之中。薇薇安對努爾抱有好感,卻連點燃神殿聖火的使命都被萊利娜奪走而懷恨在心,而此時,有一個人暗中接近她。

programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從聖經的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習聖經中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想聖經教導

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時,碰壁有時,迷失有時,覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死,迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天2 藝人﹐警察﹐過來人
programme.desc: 在社會上有三類人,他們的故事往往起伏跌宕,引人注目n藝人─身處五光十色的娛樂圈,昨日一炮而紅,今天卻隨時一沉百踩,明天,是黯淡無光抑或光輝璀璨?n員警─衝鋒陷陣,與死亡正面交鋒的職業,在捍衛他人生命和財產,讓市民有美好明天時,自己的明天又能否好好捍衛?n過來人─昔日在黑道中打混,見盡各種腥風血雨的

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:照神的慈愛恩待他 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 元宵佳節，三位主持聯同「主婦look」示人的黃建東，闖進銅鑼灣鬧市應節，測試市民對男、女有關歇後語的認識。麥美恩、吳幸美被大學講師廖舜禧問到「拍拖」出處、「氹」字的正寫，可有獨到見解？俗語「三七二十一」出於戰國時代？且聽舜禧溯本尋源。主持們及後到訪鏡畫舖、磁廠及糖水店，又何以搬出「強盜照鏡」、「豬乸噍田螺」、「竹織鴨」等歇後語？「酸薑竹」比喻玩弄女士的男子，鄭寶鴻淺談當中歷史掌故。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 美恩、幸美和茶餐廳老闆有個約會，探究「大髀痛」、「和尚跳海」，以及「打荷」等茶餐廳、食店廚房術語的奧妙。大學講師廖舜禧細談歷史人物歇後語，還講解「茅根竹」等「縮腳歇後語」特色、奄尖的「奄」與打尖的「尖」本字，及「一蚊雞」（一元）出處。「北角夜總會」形容別人經常遲到，掌故專家鄭寶鴻趣談這間娛樂場所的威水史！主持們又到訪文具展覽館與繡花鞋店，實地活用「甩頭筆」、「繡花姑娘打架」等相關歇後語，格外傳神！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 下白泥是野餐好地點，今集遊戲全部與食物有關。首次參與遊戲的蝦頭，飢餓得要用「泰山壓頂」招數來吃懸在對手頭上的食物，哪位男藝員被寵幸？舉手可招來侍應，舉腳才可進食是甚麼玩法？藝員出醜食相盡呈現！野餐不能缺少三文治，再加上綠色醬料，一場wasabi災難又上演……Bob發揮「神預測」本色，換來全部人員最期待的大懲罰！遊戲盡顯特玩隊的人性醜惡，但天意卻讓他們出線爭獎品，「輸家」連詩雅竟有出頭天！

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生的新一個實習課頭是有機會前往神樹坪繁育園或都江堰康養區，他們剛好有機會見證熊貓寶寶誕生的一刻；站長給他們介紹怎樣照顧大熊貓生產前的起居飲食；另一位飼養員則給他們介紹怎樣照顧初生熊貓寶寶。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 未來、繪萌、凜花、安娜、莎拉、玫兒，還有瑪莉亞、鈴、杏樹、虹之咲合共十位寶石偶像，卻只有一人能被選為鑽石偶像的寶石時裝大賽終於開始。繪萌與安娜順利表演過後，面對觀眾與競爭的壓力，竟令凜花感到不安……

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄見家裡經濟財政緊絀，於是走去尋寶，多啦A夢知道後借他「尋寶機」和「飄浮噴霧」。大雄不小心害靜香的胸針掉進水塘，用過法寶「加醋減醋」後心生一計，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇諸多阻撓。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 在翼的努力之下，Ultras的工作漸上軌道，但A太卻因為一次誤會而抱怨翼把B-PROJECT放在優先，本身對Ultras頗有微詞的剛士因而與A太發生衝突，詎料此時公司卻下令要B-PROJECT發展YourTube，理想做法自然是請教精於此道的Ultras。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 發掘「魔都」隱世美食，來到地道麵館，婭溦、糖妹按照網上排名點菜，蛤蜊豬肝拌麵、茄盒、腰花辣肉湯麵，果真名不虛傳。光顧傳聞「怪脾氣」師傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕與人氣脆香鮮肉月餅，風味小吃滋味連連。主持們被「古董花園」復古氛圍吸引，優雅地淺嚐美式鬆餅與造型蛋糕。接着遊逛老上海歐式風格小區，先打卡再覓食。入黑，味蕾試試新口味，主打越南粉的東南亞餐廳，可會是兩位主持杯茶？酒吧內的雞尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽向來注重固本培元，並以簡單食材製作多款養顏美食，從內到外散發健康風采。莙薘菜又名「豬乸菜」，外表平凡卻含豐富營養。以莙薘菜及多種蔬菜做成的上素卷，質感爽脆口味清新，更是都市人的減壓珍品。炮製「花生眉豆螺頭雞腳湯」要選用「老母雞」，到底有何特別功效？另一佳餚以「自然豬腩片」配上有助抗衰老的紫淮山、鮮百合，刁鑽選材全為吃得更安心。同場加映「秘製蜜汁燒焗豬肋條」，藉着啖啖肉滋味，滿足6號的肉食喜好。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 不同產地的木瓜，質感、甜度各有分別，肥媽和6號往果欄逐一介紹，並為是日「泰好味」餐單搜羅食材。青木瓜沙律拌入豆豉鯪魚，帶來嶄新口感；6號大受刺激，竟模仿阿媽唱腔！用自家製青咖喱醬煮出的「青咖喱雞」，則是「送飯」佳餚。「泰式魚露鳳爪」以檸檬、青檸、白醋等混合的酸汁浸醃，味道層次豐富。期間6號鳳爪、雞腳不分，又提起無骨鳳爪的都市傳聞，被阿媽直斥無知！此外，要令「冬蔭功」內的蝦肉爽口不霉，肥媽有何秘訣？

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 四人到清邁郊外等待看日出，並訴說相關經歷。和嘉洛同往看日出許願竟是兩男？JW最有記憶的日出，是與吳業坤一起拍劇。畏高的JW鼓起勇氣試玩動力滑翔傘，降落即要求擁抱互勉。登艇遊河兼食船麵，甚麼令陳瀅眼濕濕？走進市場，大家開始試吃之行，JW獻出食榴槤第一次。主持們換上民族服，邊品嚐地道美食邊欣賞民族表演。四人分組在周末市集買食物開餐，同時考驗另類默契。挑戰叢林間的過山車與飛索，JW能否再次戰勝恐懼？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 深入清邁鄉村逛小店，朱仔竟踴躍發言，拍檔都配合地轉為「靜音模式」。朱仔更挑戰JW底線要其吃蜜蜂蛋，嚇得她落荒而逃！四人分享清邁之旅難忘點滴，有人講到喊，更發覺此行絕對不容嘉洛缺席！大家還透過收到的禮物，競猜自己的「秘密天使」……張振朗、賴慰玲接力出發，辦理飛澳洲的登機手續之際，朱仔驚喜送機，卻是「計中計」，他會乘坐航班的商務位同行。站在海水中央食蠔，可有特別感受？不過，振朗的熟練開蠔技術才是焦點！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 很多父母都有一套取悅兒女的「殺手鐧」，好爸爸李忠希了解兩歲半囡囡最愛甜食，因此經常炮製簡單甜品，讓女兒透過味蕾品嚐父親對她的關愛。泡芙製作過程看似簡單，但不少朋友在家中試做時卻不知從何入手。「甜品達人」古嘉俊就跟大家分享心得，示範一款口感和味道皆與眾不同的「椰子杏仁泡芙」。以牛油曲奇配搭外脆內軟的泡芙，創意十足。泡芙外層換上黃糖製成的酥皮，造型彷如港式菠蘿包，箇中構思是否與忠希最愛懷舊甜品有關？

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 東海總部出現天才駕駛員，憑一人之力便戰勝UNKNOWN。太晴等人前往名古屋拜會該駕駛員，得知對方叫魚虎天，年紀更少於他們。良太和茜就天的事情發生爭執，天的適性值卻在訓練中突然急遽下降。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 熱愛一件事情，努力去做，一定會有好成績。這回「My Little Show」的兩位表演者，湊巧都是帶來舞蹈演出。想成就一段優美的舞步，相信都曾下過不少苦功，更要克服種種困難，一同看看二人如何藉舞蹈展現自信與活力。很多歌曲都陪着我們成長，寫下了青春印記，彤彤姐姐、玲玲姐姐分別細談小時候喜愛的歌曲與夢想。兩人還在結他導師的伴奏下，一起合唱<青春頌和<一生何求，唱歌的同時，也可細味歌詞中的人生哲理。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 人氣偶像姜姜主演的電影片場收到怪盜M的犯罪預告，說要偷走傳說中的寶刀玻璃丸，屁屁偵探應小鈴請求去到片場，眾人在導演安排下參與電影拍攝，屁屁偵探揭破姜姜的經理人扁口魚是怪盜M假冒。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 宏志嚮往鄉郊生活，但遭到媽媽反對，適逢鄉郊有人賣屋，宏志於是帶同小丸子和爺爺去看屋。老人會舉行馬拉松比賽，詎料未開始已有過半數人棄權，為了吸引家人參加，友藏訛稱比賽有豐富獎品。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 中國人愛金，根據世界黃金協會統計，2024年中國人的黃金購買量連續12年位居世界第一。地緣政局不穩，黃金作為資金避難所，價格創下歷史新高，升穿5,500美元一盎司。有業內人士指，現正經歷「黃金大時代」。而白銀亦追落後，兩者價格大幅波動。金銀價格大起大跌，對業內人士有何衝擊? 又如何應對呢？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 導師分組賽繼續上演，紅隊布志綸、紫隊高少華、綠隊張嘉銘三大導師帶領下，舉行三個回合的合唱比拼，各隊代表組合分別演繹Beyond樂隊、王菲、林憶蓮的作品。這集最低分的隊伍，會有兩人被淘汰。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 太極樂隊加入樂壇40年，成軍是更久的日子，如何維繫友誼？「你問我答」有歌手卻疑似目睹他們曾黑面吵架，事實又是如何？泳兒的提問，竟令劉賢德被指有所偏心！訪談其間，朱翰博突然自稱「萬能插蘇」，這別名因何得來？也講起某成員的投資之道，不論是照相機鏡頭還是身邊伴侶，都穩有盈餘？入行40周年演唱會，可準備了甚麼驚喜？太極還會在螢幕前演繹<紅色跑車、<留住我吧、<全人類高歌等金曲，讓樂迷們先聽為快！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 胡美貽與鼎爺品嚐古法粵菜，包括鮮味十足的鷓鴣粥、工序繁複的雞子戈渣，以及肉嫩多汁的黑松露手撕炸子雞，令人回味無窮。伍倩彤走訪上環的排隊熱店，遍嚐充滿創意的特脆菠蘿包、氮氣奶茶及韓式炸雞意式三文治，滋味獨特。胡美貽再駕車載廖慧儀前往大美督，到訪慧儀推介的隱世台式餐廳，試吃滿漢三寶牛肉麵、麻辣鴨血冬粉，風味正宗。Agnes則帶施焯日細嚐新派精緻福建菜，永春老醋海蜇凍酸香濃郁、紅蟳糯米飯鮮味「爆燈」！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#6粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰質問曉晨為何出現在密室中，曉晨自知瞞不住，只好帶晟杰到飛飛家，但去到後發現飛飛已被發哥抓走。曉晨和晟杰趕到貨倉贖飛飛之時，遇上霆釗及其手下，曉晨展現出她的好身手，並開槍擊斃殺手，令晟杰感到詫異。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾星戲癮發作，合演特工小劇場，旨在介紹逾百年歷史的特工主題餐廳。桌上甫見到豬肉的肥膏，朱仔隨即想起陳瀅？深入文創藝術村買手信，女生盡顯默契；四人更一起DIY手繩，陳瀅卻嫌JW破壞文青氣氛？走進聚集年輕人的市集，陳瀅獲飾品店主贈送禮物，令嘉洛要向店主問明原因！店主的熱情舉動反讓陳瀅歉疚，她即為三名拍檔買禮物，卻差點因為一隻卡通玩偶激怒朱仔？去泰國梗要按摩！兩女久候嘉洛、朱仔，要化身按摩女郎戲弄他們！

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾主持登上雙龍寺參拜，順道俯瞰清邁市風景。來到小孩遊樂場，嘉洛童心大發，陳瀅勉強陪玩，JW自認老了？兩男試玩人造沖浪卻跌不停，嘉洛還遇上小意外，引來女拍檔們追究？邊吃邊聊，JW揭露陳瀅曾致電向她哭訴。泰式餐廳設有一個園林美景，眾人彷如置身於仙境中用餐。怎料嘉洛餐後大意遺下銀包，被陳瀅手抓到報復機會……入夜返回酒店，大家齊集玩問答遊戲。一條誰人最有義氣的問題，陳瀅的答案卻令兩男傷心「中箭」？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 很多父母都有一套取悅兒女的「殺手鐧」，好爸爸李忠希了解兩歲半囡囡最愛甜食，因此經常炮製簡單甜品，讓女兒透過味蕾品嚐父親對她的關愛。泡芙製作過程看似簡單，但不少朋友在家中試做時卻不知從何入手。「甜品達人」古嘉俊就跟大家分享心得，示範一款口感和味道皆與眾不同的「椰子杏仁泡芙」。以牛油曲奇配搭外脆內軟的泡芙，創意十足。泡芙外層換上黃糖製成的酥皮，造型彷如港式菠蘿包，箇中構思是否與忠希最愛懷舊甜品有關？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生的新一個實習課頭是有機會前往神樹坪繁育園或都江堰康養區，他們剛好有機會見證熊貓寶寶誕生的一刻；站長給他們介紹怎樣照顧大熊貓生產前的起居飲食；另一位飼養員則給他們介紹怎樣照顧初生熊貓寶寶。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#49粵

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#1粵PG
programme.desc: 蕭秀瓊得知豆腐師傅入醫院，立即驅車返廠幫忙生產豆腐。王兆明服侍大富豪華少妥妥貼貼，但仍被罵得狗血淋頭。秀瓊得知老闆傅德正私會小三，走入單位捉姦時只見兆明在屋內。德正兒子竇彰學成歸來，在豆品廠從頭學起。竇彰有意投資黃豆期貨，秀瓊不贊成。華少和楊老闆在慶功宴上逼使兆明脫褲，兆明毅然辭職。兆明知道竇彰有意改革家族豆品生意，主動為竇彰寫建議書。兆明不滿曉盈向華少求情；曉盈和兆明分手，竟將扭蛋機轉送司徒嵐。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 阿百收留了出走的一織和三月，大和則獲得阿千收留。凪透露自己被人跟蹤，故要加強保安。眾人寂寞難耐，阿陸打電話給一織望和好，卻吵架收場。大和受不住阿千的言語刺激，終於說出自己的心聲。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2759粵
programme.desc: Bonnie被某位新演員稱呼為「Bonnie姐」，杜演趁機鼓動眾人一同以此尊稱她，甚至在片場外亦以「姐」相稱。Bonnie地位提升，帶來不少好處，起初樂於被稱作「Bonnie姐」，後來卻發現不少問題，城安遂向她提議「去姐化」的方法。Bonnie照辦後成效顯著，凌凌卻認為不妥。另一方面，該名新演員突然「爆紅」，變得十分囂張，Bonnie嘗試藉着杜演來整治此人，杜演卻惹上極大麻煩……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#11粵PG
programme.desc: 楚渝向步青及奕風當面問責，幸得步青替奕風出面解釋。小茹之母佩琳和歐凱的婆婆Helen偶然相認；Helen心生妙計以增加小茹和歐凱日後的相處機會。歐凱也終於踏出勇敢的第一步，向小茹提出約會。索帕盯上寶儀，似乎心懷不軌。寶儀上法文班時認識了鄰座的同學，那人竟是索帕！奕風為免牽涉妙姿的感情風波而使她尷尬，決定透過佳琪來開解妙姿；妙姿向佳琪坦白與瀚東的往事……索帕帶寶儀出走，更成功擺脫妙姿。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 石青為了保護其他宮女，不願意說出真相，直到行刑時，柳兒她們趕過來說有證據，最後瑾瑜命人重審。南趙二王子祐辰安避過連番刺殺，終於抵達大唐，瑾瑜和楚楚負責接待，卻發現他身受重傷，所以將他秘密安置在三法司。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：攻你上大學粵
programme.desc: 提出分手有學問，七位「中學生」僅一人答錯，莫非都是經驗之談？大學階段，公關危機是藝人關心議題，「女神」縱答錯「黃金24小時」，仍有所得着。哲學題令四人一臉苦惱，識玩當然指定他人答！物理學「量子糾纏」同樣難以應付，「優異生」善用錦囊反彈題目，及後卻被連環集火，生物學、風險管理科學範疇可如何拆招？兩強一題定勝負，「系統理論」重點在於「系統」……大四問題與「畢業生」的主修科有關，「獎學金」似乎十拿九穩？

programme.desc: 少龍與趙盤到牛家村找嬴政，豈料只見靈位。朱姬看到手持白玉戒指的趙盤，誤以為他是嬴政，少龍決定將錯就錯，分別對應元及趙盤痛陳利害，眾無奈贊同。善柔從墨者周平手中救出呆滯試藥女子，竟是廷芳。廷芳欲自盡，善柔透露少龍悔婚有苦衷，廷芳思念少龍。善柔與廷芳到達秦境，巧遇少龍等，廷芳心頭激動，隨即黯然離去。少龍要趙盤忘記真正身分，以後是嬴政。呂不韋出城迎接朱姬與嬴政，人群中連晉聽到朱姬叫趙盤做王子政感錯愕。

programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 魔界之老師對乙鬼說，他是個只要肯做就做得到的學生。中在家長次，七松小平太，潮江文次郎幫小丸做兼職，捲入了意料之外的事件。校長掉進綾部喜八郎挖的地洞陷阱，因而大怒，禁止再挖地洞陷阱。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 平日說話的時候，要靠兩邊聲帶完整閉合才能產生清晰的聲音，一旦聲帶運作有問題，有甚麼治療方法？不少長者都有便秘的問題，可以如何從營養補充方面幫長者解決？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2760粵
programme.desc: 地雷集團舉辦頒獎禮，頒出逾百個獎項，新人員工亦有機會獲獎，而且得獎者都可獲得純金打造的獎座，成功引起話題。敢威不甘被比下去，決意舉辦「接龍頒奬禮」，務求更顯體面。為要盡量做到「人人有獎攞」，並讓獎項能為得獎者「度身訂造」，力蓮提出一個別開生面的「巧立名目」方法，最終成功擬定各個獎項及候選名單。頒獎禮當晚，若水等人滿心期待，盼望能奪得「心水」獎項，詎料……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#12粵
programme.desc: 索帕將寶儀帶到沒有訊號的魚排，劉彪、邦妮大為緊張；幸寶儀安全回家。歐凱藉電影橋段向小茹表白，她卻未有察覺。佳琪說服邦妮聘用資安公司，臥底小隊藉此駭入愛邦妮的電腦系統。寶儀藉故支走妙姿，讓索帕潛入家中。幸妙姿發現端倪，與劉彪等趕回家中，劉彪看見索帕感愕然。索帕遭毒打，小茹為他療傷，索帕道出自己的淒慘人生。小茹、佳琪查出嘉盈的帳號被學年盜用；妙姿大受打擊，忍不住在眾人面前暴露出自己認識嘉盈！

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 南趙王稱派辰安出使只是把他當成棋子。楚楚因積案過多疲於驗屍，瑾瑜決定招仵作協助。楚河透露曾救助辰安，並說出辰安身世，瑾瑜上報皇帝後准辰安入三法司。辰安獻珍貴圖譜，楚楚發現圖譜人體結構竟與瑾瑜極其相似。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：攻你上大學粵
programme.desc: 台慶綜藝《攻你上大學》，由林盛斌率領2025年港姐亞軍施宇琪、季軍袁文靜主持。這是一個以校園為主題的知識問答節目，學術與娛樂性兼備，帶給觀眾新穎的觀賞體驗。問答題目涵蓋小學至大學程度，藝員們會穿上校服參與。眾星從小學問題開始作答，角逐升學席位；如能善用「讀書錦囊」，可望令升學更順利。過程緊張刺激，全面考驗藝員的知識水平與臨場反應。每輪勝出者除了袋走獎金外，並會晉身台慶夜的終極比拼，爭奪更豐厚大獎！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#20粵
programme.desc: 秦王封朱姬為華貴夫人，少龍為太傅。二王子成蟜及楊泉君頓感受威脅。不韋宴請少龍與嬴政，二人駭見自稱嫪毐的連晉成為不韋新收劍客。少龍約見嫪毐，嫪毐說出殺真嫪毐經過，又願與少龍合作扶助嬴政登基，少龍半信半疑。趙國派趙德來賀嬴政回國，趙德卻指嬴政是假冒，秦王早知調包之事，怒趕趙德離開。趙德跟不韋洽談買賣，不韋錯摸以為趙德知道嬴政是其私生子；少龍求見懇求不韋賜死，不韋一呆。少龍略施小計令不韋釋疑並毒殺趙德。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 祖藍先試一家在莞城廣受街坊好評的餐廳，在這裡，除了品嚐地道美食之外，他更會第一次嘗試「處理美食」— 沙蟲。之後，祖藍當然要去尋找一項珍貴的東莞非遺— 千角燈，並向傳承人了解千角燈背後的故事，以及體驗製作過程有多麼不容易。來到夜晚時間，新光明市場的夜市就是不二選擇……

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#2粵
programme.desc: 竇彰宣佈增聘人手改革豆品廠，秀瓊、丹丹和德正見到新同事是兆明，當場嚇呆。眾人認定德正和竇彰必受兆明擺佈，秀瓊誓保豆品廠。秀瓊帶兆明參觀，兆明終於找到豆品廠問題所在。兆明走到司徒嵐的咖啡店，司徒嵐對他好言安慰，介紹她的合作夥伴給兆明認識；期間攝影師菲兒為他們拍照。秀瓊批評兆明外行領導內行，司徒嵐認為他的說話不中聽大可不理。涂威龍收到告票，秀瓊打算將罰款算入公司雜項賬，兆明認為是威龍的錯失應由他負責。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#50粵
programme.desc: 眾人終揭發娜破壞高家安寧，對她態度惡劣，義卻站在娜一邊。義準備搞生意，在眾人面前向慶要錢不果，令義離家出走，與娜同居。同居後義露出「大食懶」的本性，令娜忍受不了，除道出裝病的真相，更向義提出分手。

programme.title: 天龍八部#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 虛竹得知女童的真實身分是天山童姥，決定要回少林；游坦之要護送阿紫回遼國，但全冠清故意慫恿遊坦之留下來；李秋水欲把天山童姥置之死地，虛竹怒斥李秋水手段狠絕；在童姥的指引下，虛竹背著童姥溜進西夏皇宮躲避…

programme.title: 家家行運菜粵
programme.desc: 主持麥長青(麥包)今集請來黃長興煮出「中法」合璧的「大三元寶」，蕭正楠亦送上由父親向印度人「偷師」的秘製咖哩雞。「行運嘉賓」鍾舒漫、黃心穎和王祖藍，會與主持一起炮製自家行運菜。吳業坤難得可以和心穎一起下廚，自然出動吳家賀年菜「心坤相印」！廚藝不精的王祖藍，對於麥包的家鄉煎釀鯪魚有甚麼評價？舒漫與王君馨炮製健康沙律「萬家興旺」，加上鍾家秘製辣椒醬，竟令大家唱起經典歌曲<小老鼠與大花貓！

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 舞獅、舞龍、舞麒麟名列本港首份非物質文化遺產清單。冒卓祺是香港鮮有的麒麟紮作師傅，由零開始，製作一隻麒麟需多長時間？除示範紮麒麟的預備工夫，冒師傅亦帶大家參與「麒麟開光儀式」。何以進行開光儀式要遠離民居並在清晨舉行？放下鑼鼓，換上嘻哈音樂，醒獅亦能變成「嘻哈舞獅」新潮流！龍獅團負責人譚定邦、譚定基致力推廣舞獅，亦樂於教授外籍人士，傳揚中國傳統。對他們而言，教授外籍人士除言語不通外，還遇過甚麼困難？

programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S2
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.desc: Katy needs help; she's feeling sick! Troy selects the most helpful, kindest car he knows: Amber the Ambulance!

programme.desc: Suzy had an accident and needs urgent help! Troy selects the most perfect vehicle to help rescue her: Hector the Helicopter!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.desc: To be released from a terrifying voice, Derya must do as it says and follow the one man closest to her, Onur - her boss and childhood friend. Soon enough Derya uncovers some shocking truths about him and is caught up in a dangerous web.

programme.title: The Apple of My Eye
programme.desc: Elise is beautiful, funny, and blind. Theo is a seducer but a loser. They love music. But when they meet in the elevator, it's hate at first sight.

programme.title: Sweet Dreams
programme.desc: Dutch tycoon Jan dies suddenly in Indonesia, leaving his wife Agathe in shock. Their son and his pregnant wife come from the Netherlands to inherit the family empire and are dismayed to find out that Jan's mistress Siti has a crucial role in his will.

programme.title: Azam and Johan - EP10
programme.desc: Azam & Johan bercita-cita menjadi pemain bola sepak profesional. Kemalangan menyebabkan Azam lumpuh, memusnahkan impian bola sepaknya. Ibu mereka menyalahkan Johan atas kemalangan itu.

programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise there's nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Band
programme.desc: Fifi, Little Woo and Fred call up Stanley to ask him to film their new song. They go around the town trying to find the perfect place.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Double the Fun
programme.desc: Freddie is visiting Aunt Fee, who is baking a cake. Freddie makes a pretend campsite on the rug in the living room for him, Aunt Fee, Alan Acorn and Charlie The Shark.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time For An Easter Feast
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and all the family plan an Easter feast. When there isn't enough space in the kitchen to prepare the food, it's time for a Gran Gran plan outside in the garden.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Medicine Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's not very well, he's lost his voice. The Squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water but the Squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pizza Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are... interesting!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Map Readers
programme.desc: Glitch races the Go Jetters across the Academy to find the lost G.O. Dome of the Ancients.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Banana
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits Theatre, it's Banana revealing an astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, I've Got a Secret.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Grapes
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits Theatre, it's the spectacular acrobatic grapes working together to perform the most difficult structures to perfection.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Evil Pea Takes a Break
programme.desc: The Cobs try to capture Supertato while Evil Pea is on holiday, but it goes wrong, resulting in Evil Pea getting covered in flour and custard over in the Bath Product's Aisle.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Super Birthday
programme.desc: Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea comes to his birthday party but Carrot is suspicious. Soon Evil Pea unleashes the Mini Peas who try to steal Supertato's birthday present.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stairs

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S2) - Cat

programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pizza Badge

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Super Birthday

programme.desc: Evil Pea thinks the Veggies won't like it when she covers the Supermarket in ice, but instead they have the best snow day ever, so she creates a giant snowball to ruin their fun.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Go Outside
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po want to go outside but it's raining. Some wellies and umbrellas magically appear and the Teletubbies go outside for splashy, rainy fun.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - "Black Leopard". Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of "Black Leopard", except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: This is adapted from Louis Cha's "The Book and the Sword". A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses, and is caught between all their affections for him.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu".

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. _x000D_An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one.

programme.title: Africa Live

Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.
